title: Logitech G29 Rev LEDs
tag_line: Wheel rev LEDs follow BeamNG engine RPM, scaled to each car's redline.
text:
[b]Logitech G Rev LEDs[/b]
Drives the rev/shift LEDs on a Logitech G29 steering wheel from BeamNG engine RPM (only the G29 is tested; other Logitech G wheels with rev LEDs may work).

This mod adds a tiny UDP telemetry protocol that sends current RPM plus the car's redline. Run the companion app [b]logi-revleds.exe[/b] to light the wheel LEDs. The LED bar scales to each car's own idle->redline range, so it feels the same across vehicles.

LEDs are driven via raw HID and do not interfere with the wheel's input or force feedback.
